_comment: Classification anchors for Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663).
Every entry records HOW it was identified, so a reader can audit or
disprove a label without trusting the author. Nothing here is derived
from a token's name -- names are the weakest possible signal and are

chain.public_launch_note: 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z, found by binary search over block timestamps. Block 1 is 2026-04-30 -- the chain ran 62 days before the announced launch.

0x0bd7d308f8e1639fab988df18a8011f41eacad.label: WETH
0x0bd7d308f8e1639fab988df18a8011f41eacad.evidence: name()='WETH', decimals()=18; wraps the chain's ETH gas token. First mint block 9482.

0x89e5db8b5aa49aa85ac63f691524311aeb649e.label: Uniswap V2 Router
0x89e5db8b5aa49aa85ac63f691524311aeb649e.evidence: exposes factory() -> 0x8bceaa40... and WETH() -> 0x0bd7d308...; appears as first_tx_to for 164 UNI-V2 LP tokens.

0x8bceaa40b9acdfaedf85adf4ff01f5ad651793.label: Uniswap V2 Factory
0x8bceaa40b9acdfaedf85adf4ff01f5ad651793.evidence: returned by router.factory(); emits PairCreated; allPairsLength() = 39941 at scan time.

0x5818fddddb96bcd50bee4253f11b324e7dea96.label: launchpad-A
0x5818fddddb96bcd50bee4253f11b324e7dea96.evidence: owner() is the same EOA that deployed the three placeholder '.' tokens at blocks 61208/61472/61483 -- the operator testing its own product. Exposes WETH() and emits Uniswap V2 PairCreated itself, so it is a UniV2-fork factory with a launch wrapper.
0x5818fddddb96bcd50bee4253f11b324e7dea96.quirk: Its tokens ARE their own AMM pair -- getReserves() succeeds on the token address. Vanity addresses end in 0000.
0x5818fddddb96bcd50bee4253f11b324e7dea96.public_name: unknown -- could not be established from on-chain data

0xd9ec2db5f3d1b236843925949fe5bd8a3836fc.label: NOXA Fun
0xd9ec2db5f3d1b236843925949fe5bd8a3836fc.evidence: owner() is the EOA that deployed the token named 'Testing NOXA Fun ;)' at block 61394. Appears as mint_to for 3276 tokens (bonding-curve style: the launchpad holds the supply).
0xd9ec2db5f3d1b236843925949fe5bd8a3836fc.note: This is the contract block explorers report as the CREATOR of every token launched through it, including CASHCAT.

0x0c37a24f5d23a486fa692d1500881d698b1f77.label: Pons
0x0c37a24f5d23a486fa692d1500881d698b1f77.evidence: Deployed at block 8600612 (its first log is OwnershipTransferred to 0xda4bcee7...). Its first launch event, topic0 0x1461370115e1c2be..., created token 0xf4eaec43... named 'Test' at block 8621658, launched by the same wallet that deployed the launchpad -- the operator smoke-testing its own product, the same pattern as launchpad-A and NOXA Fun.
0x0c37a24f5d23a486fa692d1500881d698b1f77.note: The chain's dominant launchpad (167,000+ tokens per its own site). Confirmed by two independent methods: parsing its launch events, and brute-force checking all 10,102 tokens born between its deployment and the PONS token -- both return exactly 2 (Test, then PONS).
0x0c37a24f5d23a486fa692d1500881d698b1f77.platform_token: 0x39dbed3a2bd333467115de45665cc57f813c4571 (PONS), launched block 8963150 by 0xb9f5f4ea... at nonce 0, i.e. a wallet created for the purpose
0x0c37a24f5d23a486fa692d1500881d698b1f77.codebase_note: Emits the same event signatures as NOXA Fun but is NOT the same contract: 24192 bytes vs 22811, different bytecode. Forks of a common template.

0xa5aab3f0c6eeadf30ef1d3eb997108e976351f.label: Pons Launch Factory
0xa5aab3f0c6eeadf30ef1d3eb997108e976351f.evidence: Verified on Blockscout as contract name 'PonsLaunchFactory'. owner() is 0x263ed295..., itself a verified SafeProxy (multisig), which is what an operating team looks like rather than an individual. Routes 195,854 tokens from 68,892 distinct launchers across blocks 9,019,252-22,583,298 -- the largest launchpad on the chain at 30.8% of all attributed tokens. Distinct from the already-listed Pons contract 0x0c37a24f..., which is the earlier/other Pons deployment.

0x26605f322f7ff986f381bb9a6e3f5dab0beaeb.label: launchpad-B
0x26605f322f7ff986f381bb9a6e3f5dab0beaeb.evidence: Verified on Blockscout as a TransparentUpgradeableProxy; EIP-1967 implementation slot points to 0xa3b96df56f254b926b17d5f7fb6cd858c216ff44, which is unverified, so the product name is not recoverable on chain and no name is asserted. Identified as a launchpad by routing: 122,519 tokens from 13,046 distinct launchers across blocks 4,227,932-22,583,328 (19.3% of attributed tokens). Its first token is 'TestToken' (symbol Test) at block 4,227,932, followed by a Uniswap V2 pair token one block later -- the same operator-smoke-test-then-pool pattern seen at launchpad-A and NOXA Fun.

0xf193ede778a92dc37cb450a1ef1565ed1e8b79.label: launchpad-C
0xf193ede778a92dc37cb450a1ef1565ed1e8b79.evidence: Unverified contract, no owner()/factory() getter responds, so no name is asserted. Identified as a launchpad by routing alone: 29,615 tokens from 9,831 distinct launchers across blocks 7,490,602-22,582,550 (4.7% of attributed tokens). Tens of thousands of tokens sharing one callee is the clustering signal described in the README; the launcher-to-token ratio of 3:1 rules out a single deployer bot.

0xcdca5d374e46a6dddab50bd2d9acb8c796ec35.label: canonical-asset minter
0xcdca5d374e46a6dddab50bd2d9acb8c796ec35.evidence: This contract executes the first mint for LINK, wstETH and syrupUSDG, AND returns the same owner() as the tokens it mints. That makes those tokens mint/burn representations of off-chain assets, not launches.
0xcdca5d374e46a6dddab50bd2d9acb8c796ec35.caveat: These tokens do NOT expose l1Address(), so they are not Arbitrum standard-gateway tokens. 'Bridged' here means custom mint/burn representation.

0x2b94105fff37630f98e1f24811dad588fc5c3a.label: Robinhood stock-token issuer EOA
0x2b94105fff37630f98e1f24811dad588fc5c3a.evidence: deployed 95 tokens starting block 34714, including 'Roundhill Weekly T-Bill ETF • Robinhood' (WEEK).

0x4262efbd176f02824af27010bea218429c33c7.label: wrapped stock-token factory
0x4262efbd176f02824af27010bea218429c33c7.evidence: first_tx_to for 72 wrapped stock tokens (wWEEK, wAAOI). codelen 130 -- a minimal proxy factory.

_name_marker.evidence: RWA stock tokens carry this issuer suffix in name(). Used only as a SECONDARY signal alongside deployer identity.

0x0000000071727de22e5e9d8baf0edac6f37da0.label: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7
0x0000000071727de22e5e9d8baf0edac6f37da0.evidence: canonical cross-chain EntryPoint address; 11,309 tokens deployed through it via smart-account transactions, submitted by only 24 distinct tx senders.
0x0000000071727de22e5e9d8baf0edac6f37da0.note: Not a launchpad, and tx.from here is a BUNDLER, not the launcher. The 24 senders are bundlers relaying other people's UserOperations; the three busiest accounted for 2,997 / 2,802 / 2,287 tokens while routing 100% through this address, a profile no human launcher has. The real account is the indexed `sender` of the UserOperationEvent emitted per operation; `scan.py userops` resolves it into aa_sender.

0x4337084d9e255ff0702461cf8895ce9e3b5ff1.label: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.8
0x4337084d9e255ff0702461cf8895ce9e3b5ff1.evidence: canonical cross-chain EntryPoint address; 1 token observed deployed through it in the attributed range.

0x5ff137d4b0fdcd49dca30c7cf57e578a026d27.label: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.6
0x5ff137d4b0fdcd49dca30c7cf57e578a026d27.evidence: canonical cross-chain EntryPoint address. NOT observed on this chain: zero tokens routed through it in the attributed range.
0x5ff137d4b0fdcd49dca30c7cf57e578a026d27.note: Listed because the address is canonical and fixed across chains, so a v0.6 deployment would otherwise be silently misattributed to its bundler. This entry is a guard, not a finding.

staging_window.evidence: In blocks 0-58539 (36 days, 2026-05-11 to 2026-06-15) exactly 16 distinct EOAs deployed any ERC-20. In the next 38000 blocks that jumps to 148 and the first public launchpad appears. Every token in that window is a partner/protocol deployment.
staging_window.note: This is a population statistic, not a read on token names. IMPORTANT: it does NOT show the chain was permissioned. MARIAN (block 58539) was deployed by an EOA outside those 16 and succeeded, so nothing was blocking non-partner deployment. The low count reflects the chain being unannounced and undiscovered, not an allowlist. Treat this as evidence about who was PRESENT, not about who was PERMITTED.

0x01637b14b7378b99de75a64d50656d98488d9a.label: MARIAN / Lady Marian -- first independent launch
0x01637b14b7378b99de75a64d50656d98488d9a.evidence: first-mint tx 0x65ae852367a231c97952716bcaef8b8ffa9d19cec8d0cdc24a9924187e78ada1 has to=null (direct EOA deploy, no factory). owner() returns the zero address -- renounced.

0x68184c449e1a8f34fa18d289737129fd27b66f.label: USDG / Global Dollar -- earliest ERC-20 contract found
0x68184c449e1a8f34fa18d289737129fd27b66f.evidence: found by the contract-creation pass, NOT the mint scan: totalSupply() == 0, so it never emitted a mint and is invisible to a Transfer-from-zero scan. Creation tx 0x5a88b74f8ade975f0fbb8908b70cde112d64b263c9b60967996bb20314d48769.
0x68184c449e1a8f34fa18d289737129fd27b66f.note: Distinct contract from the USDG at block 433 that did mint.

endpoint_limits._comment: Empirically calibrated. These make the difference between a 100-minute scan and a 100-hour one.
endpoint_limits.getlogs_error: logs matched by query exceeds limit of 10000
endpoint_limits.parallelism_note: The limiter is a per-IP token bucket priced by method cost. Opening parallel connections LOWERS throughput: 3 threads measured 68 blk/s vs 118 single-threaded. Keep the scanner serial.
endpoint_limits.user_agent_note: A default Python/urllib User-Agent receives HTTP 403. A curl-like UA works.
